name: local-business-research
title: Local Business Research
description: Research public information about a company: services, locations, contact information, service areas, descriptions, public reviews, imagery, branding and competitors - source-aware.
when_to_use: A specific business is named, or an existing site/listing is available.
instructions: Record every claim with its classification: VERIFIED_FACT (stated by a fetched source you cite by id), SOURCE_DERIVED (reasonably derived from cited sources), INFERENCE (your reasoning), UNVERIFIED.
Cite sources by the research source ids provided in TOOL EVIDENCE; never invent URLs or source ids.
Contact details, addresses, licences, years in business and reviews are only facts when a cited source states them.
If nothing could be fetched, say so and return only INFERENCE/UNVERIFIED claims.
